sar.narrative: Customer C02265, holder of card C02265-K1, is the subject of this suspicious activity report following a monitoring alert for structuring. Between 2016-12-02 19:00 and 2016-12-02 19:30, four online transactions totaling $1,904.86 were executed on the card within a 30-minute window. The individual transactions were $481.66 on transaction 3507563 at 19:00, $468.32 on transaction 3507591 at 19:08, $485.41 on transaction 3507626 at 19:20, and $469.47 on transaction 3507670 at 19:30. Every amount was kept just under a $500 authorization threshold, matching a suspicious pattern where band bursts indicate an evasion of standard controls. This activity is considered anomalous because the $485.41 transaction significantly exceeds the card's median of $58.03 and 95th percentile of $204.98, and product code C had never been used previously on this card. The purchases were conducted using the device profile 'Windows | Windows 10 | chrome 64.0 | 1920x1080', which had one prior transaction on the card. Furthermore, this behavior closely mirrors eight of the eight most similar closed fraud cases, including CC-3907, CC-3841, CC-4124, and CC-4086, all of which were confirmed as fraud. In response to these findings, the bank has automatically created a case and escalated the matter to an analyst, while executing an L1 human approval action to block the card and an L2 action to file this report.
